description: This file declares the class CThermalMonitor which provides functionalities related to thermal monitoring within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for retrieving and setting temperature thresholds and reporting temperature events.

classes.name: CThermalMonitor
classes.description: A class for thermal monitoring functionalities, including getting core temperature, thresholds, and reporting temperature threshold changes.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CThermalMonitor.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Registers a SystemServices instance as an event observer.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes a previously registered SystemServices observer.

methods.name: emitTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a temperature threshold has been crossed.

methods.name: getCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Gets the current high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: setCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets the high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: reportTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Reports a change in the temperature threshold status.
